title: 5-axis CNC milling of aerofoils
description: 5-axis CNC milling of aerofoils capability for titanium components

processComparison.laser: Ra 0.8 µm standard; Ra 0.2 µm with finishing pass
Unrestricted — tool can approach from any angle
processComparison.waterjet: Limited — each setup indexes the part

processDescription: 5-axis CNC milling centers provide simultaneous multi-axis interpolation for complex titanium components. The ability to tilt the tool relative to the workpiece surface maintains optimal chip load and extends tool life, critical for difficult-to-machine titanium alloys, specifically for valve. Precision valve for Aerospace present unique challenges: Seat leakage Class VI (ANSI FCI 70-2) requires lapped sealing surfaces. Stem straightness ±0.02 mm over 500 mm.
heatControl: High-pressure coolant-through-spindle (50–70 bar) with coated carbide tooling. Adaptive trochoidal milling paths reduce radial engagement to control heat generation.
flatnessControl: Stress-relieved raw material and sequenced roughing/finishing passes. Heat-sink fixturing for thin-wall sections minimizes thermal distortion.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for 5-axis CNC milling of aerofoils, utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
